title: Free Cozy Game
author: IllConsideration9821
selftext:
​

Hey Reddit Friends! 

So, I've never done this before but I made a little virtual pet cozy game and I'd love for you to give it a try. You can collect cute pets and backgrounds, play games, grow a garden and compete in shows. It's a fun, safe, place to relax for adults and kids alike. 😊 

A Little Note About Whimsy 💜 

Whimsy is a small, independently created virtual pet game built from a love of cute creatures, cozy gardens, and a little bit of imagination. 

Some of the artwork in Whimsy was created with the help of generative AI. I know AI art is a complicated and sometimes controversial subject, and I respect that people have different feelings about it. 

For me, AI is a creative tool that allows me to bring characters and ideas to life that I wouldn't otherwise have the artistic skills or resources to create myself. The creatures, world, gameplay, and creative direction behind Whimsy are all part of the project I dreamed up and built. 

I'm also continuing to learn about the concerns surrounding AI and the artists whose work has helped shape the creative world we all enjoy. 

If AI-generated artwork isn't for you, I completely understand. But if you're willing to give Whimsy a chance, I hope you'll find that there's a whole lot more to it than how the pictures were made. 🐾🌱✨ Also, if you're an artist that is interested in collaborating, please don't hesitate to reach out! ❤️ 

https://whimsypet.lovable.app/
